meta.governance_note: These are task-local candidate lessons. They MUST NOT modify canonical governance files (rules.json, lessons.json, incidents.json) without explicit formal promotion.

candidate_lessons.title: CORPUS-WIDE REPORT CLAIMS REQUIRE DIRECT MACHINE-REPRODUCIBLE EVIDENCE
candidate_lessons.description: A report stated corpus-wide raster properties (dimensions, dtype, CRS, size, count) without preserving the machine-readable scan artifact that produced those claims. A CORPUS-WIDE FACT requires CURRENT DIRECT MEASUREMENT OR CRYPTOGRAPHICALLY LINKED ARTIFACT.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Report claims were derived from partial or transient inspection outputs that were not persisted as machine-readable evidence artifacts.
candidate_lessons.evidence: The previous report contained corpus metadata claims that could not be independently verified without re-scanning the entire corpus. Fresh direct scan was required to establish ground truth.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Every corpus-wide factual claim in a report must reference a machine-readable evidence artifact (e.g., TRUJILLO_CORPUS_INVENTORY_RECONCILED.json) that is persisted and can be independently re-verified. A CORPUS-WIDE FACT requires CURRENT DIRECT MEASUREMENT OR CRYPTOGRAPHICALLY LINKED ARTIFACT.

candidate_lessons.title: A PASSED-TEST NUMBER IS NOT AUTHORITATIVE WITHOUT ACTUAL FINAL EXECUTION
candidate_lessons.description: The previous report claimed '417 backend tests passed' but did not preserve the literal final pytest output, exit code, or collection summary. Upon re-execution, `uv run pytest -q` produced 31 collection errors (torch/PIL missing) and terminated without running any tests — making the '417 passed' claim unverifiable and potentially fabricated.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Test count was reported from memory or partial execution rather than from the literal final command output with exit code 0.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Full suite `uv run pytest -q` exits with code 1 due to 31 collection errors (ModuleNotFoundError: torch, PIL). No tests are actually executed in this mode.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Final test reports must include: exact command, exit code, literal summary line, collected count, passed/failed/error/skipped counts. If collection errors exist, the suite MUST NOT be called 'N passed' — it must be reported as 'collection errors' with classification.

candidate_lessons.title: EVIDENCE CONTRADICTION BLOCKS CERTIFICATION
candidate_lessons.description: If a core factual claim in a report conflicts with existing verified evidence or fresh measurement, the milestone cannot be certified as FROZEN until the contradiction is reconciled.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Report self-audit was not treated as a verification step. The report was treated as authoritative once written, rather than as an auditable claim set.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Multiple claims in the previous report required independent re-verification against repository data.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Report claims must be treated as hypotheses until independently verified against repository evidence. Contradictions block certification.

candidate_lessons.title: DIFFERENT ANNOTATIONS DO NOT PROVE WHY THE ANNOTATIONS DIFFER
candidate_lessons.description: The previous report and implementation used phrases like 'annotation noise' or 'purely human or model annotation divergence' to explain why masks differ between identical source rasters. The evidence only establishes THAT masks differ, not WHY.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Causal language was inserted without independent evidence of the cause. Observable difference was conflated with causal explanation.
candidate_lessons.evidence: temporal_guard.py line 155-157 (original) stated 'purely annotation variance or labeling noise'. Corrected to state observable fact without claiming cause.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Scientific interpretation text must distinguish observable fact (masks differ) from causal assertion (why they differ). Only assert the cause when independent provenance proves it.

candidate_lessons.title: PRESERVED LEGACY ARTIFACTS ARE NOT AUTOMATICALLY VALID EVIDENCE
candidate_lessons.description: Artifacts in outputs/temporal/, outputs/origin_drift/, and outputs/ais/ derived from the duplicate image pair are preserved on disk but are scientifically invalid for temporal reasoning. Preservation != validity.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Artifact persistence was conflated with scientific validity. The existence of a file was treated as evidence of correctness.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Legacy artifacts derived from the 00007/01339 duplicate pair exist on disk but the pair's source_pair_status is INVALID_DUPLICATE_IMAGE_PAIR. Scenario lineage is LEGACY_INVALID_TEMPORAL_PAIR.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Artifact provenance metadata must distinguish PRESERVED (on disk) from VALID (scientifically usable). The API/UI must not present legacy-invalid artifacts as current valid evidence.

candidate_lessons.title: POTENTIAL TEMPORAL PAIR != VERIFIED TEMPORAL PAIR
candidate_lessons.description: Distinct overlapping rasters are classified as POTENTIAL_TEMPORAL_PAIR with TEMPORAL_ORDER_UNKNOWN. They require authoritative acquisition chronology before physical temporal reasoning can proceed.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Terminology was sometimes ambiguous about whether pairs were verified temporal or merely candidates.
candidate_lessons.evidence: 9,316 candidate pairs are classified with TEMPORAL_ORDER_UNKNOWN. No authoritative Sentinel-1 acquisition timestamps are embedded in the dataset.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Use POTENTIAL_TEMPORAL_PAIR consistently. Never call a pair a 'temporal pair' without verified chronology.

candidate_lessons.title: REPORT SELF-AUDIT IS PART OF ENGINEERING VERIFICATION
candidate_lessons.description: The final report itself must be treated as an auditable artifact. A report can contain implementation mistakes even when the implementation is partly correct.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Report generation was treated as a documentation step rather than a verification step. Reports were not systematically cross-checked against measured evidence.
candidate_lessons.evidence: This reconciliation task exists because the previous report contained evidence-quality inconsistencies that were not caught by the original report generation process.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Before freezing a milestone, every material factual claim in the report must be traced back to a machine-readable evidence artifact. The report generation step should include a cross-reference audit.

candidate_lessons.title: SCIENTIFIC STAGE COMPLETION REQUIRES ACTUAL EXECUTION
candidate_lessons.description: Wiring, mock fixtures, adapter presence, static references, or passing unit tests do not constitute execution of the real external scientific stage.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Unit test passage was conflated with operational stage execution.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Historical metocean and AIS ingestion stages remain BLOCKED because no authoritative external source has been successfully queried, despite adapters and test fixtures being present.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Distinguish UNIT_TEST_PASS from OPERATIONAL_STAGE_EXECUTION. A stage is only complete when live execution against verified, accredited inputs has occurred.

candidate_lessons.title: REPORT CLAIMED RUNTIME EXECUTION BUT ONLY CODE / TEST / UI-LAYER EVIDENCE EXISTED
candidate_lessons.description: A report claimed 'GUARD_EXECUTION_VERIFIED' and 'Duplicate guard behavior executed and tested', but browser verification recorded that the backend server was offline and the real pipeline job had never executed outside pytest. Test execution and mock-level UI rendering were improperly claimed as runtime execution verification.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Conflation of test-suite assertions and static/mock component rendering with true live orchestration and runtime API execution.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Previous reconciliation report claimed GUARD_EXECUTION_VERIFIED while backend server was not running. True runtime execution required launching backend and executing PipelineOrchestrator.run_job() and live API HTTP calls.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Enforce strict evidence-class hierarchy: STATIC INSPECTION ≠ UNIT TEST EXECUTION ≠ ORCHESTRATION EXECUTION ≠ LIVE API EXECUTION ≠ BROWSER END-TO-END EXECUTION. All are useful, but they are not interchangeable evidence classes. A test pass is NOT runtime execution. A runtime execution is NOT external scientific authority. A report claim is never stronger than its evidence.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: A TEST PASS IS NOT RUNTIME EXECUTION. A RUNTIME EXECUTION IS NOT EXTERNAL SCIENTIFIC AUTHORITY. A REPORT CLAIM IS NEVER STRONGER THAN ITS EVIDENCE.

candidate_lessons.title: BACKEND AVAILABILITY IS NOT SCIENTIFIC RESULT VALIDITY OR RESULT FRESHNESS
candidate_lessons.description: Backend connectivity, job execution state, cached-result state, provenance, scientific validity, and application gate are six orthogonal state dimensions. Backend unreachable after execution is not a product or scientific defect. Cached results may be viewed but must never masquerade as live current executions. When backend reconnects, cached state remains cached until fresh execution.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Conflation of daemon/network connection state with job lifecycle, result freshness, and scientific provenance.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Operator observed UI state showing 'BACKEND UNREACHABLE' with 'LAST LOADED RESULT' from previous AG execution. The development server process had stopped after execution, which is an expected dev server lifecycle event, not a product or scientific defect. Without explicit state separation, offline state could be confused with scientific failure, or reconnected state could silently masquerade stale results as fresh live executions.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Model and render SIX ORTHOGONAL STATE DIMENSIONS: CONNECTION (ONLINE / UNREACHABLE / OFFLINE), RESULT_FRESHNESS (LIVE_CURRENT / CACHED_LAST_LOADED / NONE), JOB_STATE (RUNNING / SUCCEEDED / BLOCKED / FAILED), PROVENANCE (PHYSICAL / REAL_REPOSITORY / DEMO / SYNTHETIC), SCIENTIFIC_VALIDITY (VALID_FOR_SCOPE / PROVENANCE_LIMITED / BLOCKED / LEGACY_INVALID), and APPLICATION_GATE (READY / DEGRADED / BLOCKED). Require fresh API execution or job verification before promoting CACHED_LAST_LOADED to LIVE_CURRENT. Decouple or warn when cached results do not match current scenario selection.
state_dimensions: JOB STATE: RUNNING / SUCCEEDED / BLOCKED / FAILED / UNKNOWN
PROVENANCE: PHYSICAL / REAL_REPOSITORY / DEMO / SYNTHETIC / PROVENANCE_LIMITED / UNKNOWN
SCIENTIFIC VALIDITY: VALID_FOR_SCOPE / PROVENANCE_LIMITED / BLOCKED / LEGACY_INVALID / DATA_UNAVAILABLE
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: BACKEND AVAILABILITY IS NOT SCIENTIFIC RESULT VALIDITY OR RESULT FRESHNESS. LAST LOADED RESULT MUST NEVER BE MISTAKEN FOR LIVE CURRENT SCIENTIFIC EVIDENCE.

candidate_lessons.title: WARNING-ONLY MISMATCH PROTECTION MAY NOT BE SUFFICIENT FOR SCIENTIFIC UI
candidate_lessons.description: When current operator context and loaded evidence identity differ, a warning banner alone may leave stale evidence visually actionable. Mismatched evidence must be explicitly quarantined from active interpretation while preserving its original provenance and historical identity.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Passive warning messages rely on operator vigilance while interactive hypothesis selection controls remain active, permitting accidental misattribution of evidence to an unverified context.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Operator inspection noted that selecting scenario B while viewing scenario A displayed a warning banner, but interactive hypothesis controls and 3D overlays remained live. Without quarantine, stale evidence could be visually manipulated as if active for scenario B.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Implement explicit RESULT_USAGE = QUARANTINED state whenever selectedScenarioId != result.scenario_id or activeMode != result.mode. Neutralize interactive evidence selection controls, display clear quarantine watermarks, and require fresh execution of the selected context before restoring active evidence usage. Preserves original provenance without rewriting identity.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: A WARNING MUST NOT BE THE ONLY BARRIER WHEN STALE SCIENTIFIC EVIDENCE CAN STILL APPEAR OPERATIONALLY ACTIVE. PRESERVE THE EVIDENCE. QUARANTINE ITS USE. NEVER REWRITE ITS IDENTITY.

candidate_lessons.title: RESULT FRESHNESS IS NOT SCIENTIFIC VALIDITY
candidate_lessons.description: Result freshness describes execution recency within the current application session. Scientific validity describes evidence authority and boundary limitations. Context applicability describes membership in the selected scenario/mode context. Operational actionability describes whether a particular control or interaction is permitted. These properties are orthogonal and MUST NOT be inferred from one another. A fresh live result may be provenance-limited or blocked in certain stages, while a valid result may be cached or quarantined due to context mismatch.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Conflation of execution recency (LIVE_CURRENT) with scientific authority (VALID_FOR_SCOPE), and context eligibility (RESULT_USAGE = ACTIVE) with unrestricted operational permission.
candidate_lessons.evidence: In Scenario B (TRUJILLO_00260_00608), fresh live execution against backend produces a live result with valid SAR evidence but an unresolved/blocked temporal stage. Freshness is LIVE_CURRENT while scientific validity is PROVENANCE_LIMITED. Level 1 context gate is ACTIVE, while Level 2 stage gate blocks temporal playback controls.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Decouple all state dimensions: JOB_STATE, STAGE_STATE, RESULT_FRESHNESS, SCIENTIFIC_VALIDITY, CONTEXT_APPLICABILITY, and EVIDENCE_ACTIONABILITY. Enforce two-level gating: Level 1 (context mismatch) quarantines all operational evidence controls; Level 2 (stage/item limitations) disables only affected controls without globally invalidating unrelated valid evidence. Freshness transitions to LIVE_CURRENT strictly after execution completes, result is fetched, and result identity is verified. A blocked stage must not globally invalidate unrelated valid evidence, and matching context does not automatically make every evidence control safe.
orthogonal_dimensions: RESULT FRESHNESS: LIVE_CURRENT vs CACHED_LAST_LOADED vs NONE (Recency)
SCIENTIFIC VALIDITY: VALID_FOR_SCOPE vs PROVENANCE_LIMITED vs BLOCKED vs LEGACY_INVALID (Authority)
CONTEXT APPLICABILITY: ACTIVE vs QUARANTINED vs NONE (Context Match)
EVIDENCE ACTIONABILITY: Level 2 stage/item specific gating (Permission)
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: RESULT FRESHNESS IS NOT SCIENTIFIC VALIDITY. CONTEXT APPLICABILITY IS NOT EVIDENCE ACTIONABILITY. A BLOCKED STAGE MUST NOT INVALIDATE UNRELATED VALID EVIDENCE. MATCHING CONTEXT DOES NOT AUTOMATICALLY MAKE EVERY EVIDENCE CONTROL SAFE.

candidate_lessons.title: CANONICAL STATE VOCABULARY MUST REMAIN IDENTICAL ACROSS IMPLEMENTATION, TESTS, UI, AND CLOSURE REPORTS
candidate_lessons.description: The approved 6-dimension state model (Connection State, Result Freshness, Job Execution State, Provenance Context, Scientific Validity, Application Gate) must preserve strictly identical vocabularies across types, UI badges, unit test assertions, and report summaries. Conflating Application Gate with Scientific Validity (such as rendering 'OPERATIONAL GATE: PROVENANCE-LIMITED') compromises state integrity.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Ad-hoc badge text rendering in TopBar.tsx and corresponding test assertions mixed execution mode and scientific validity labels into the Application Gate indicator.
candidate_lessons.evidence: TopBar.tsx displayed 'OPERATIONAL GATE: PROVENANCE-LIMITED' and App.test.tsx test 35 asserted that exact string, conflating Application Gate (READY) with Scientific Validity (PROVENANCE_LIMITED). Fixed to render 'APPLICATION GATE: READY' while Scientific Validity is rendered separately as 'PROVENANCE LIMITED'.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Define and export strict TypeScript types (JobExecutionState, ProvenanceContext, ScientificValidity, ApplicationGate) and enforce exact UI badge text rendering that adheres to canonical vocabulary without conflation.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: CANONICAL STATE VOCABULARIES MUST REMAIN IDENTICAL AND UNCONFLATED ACROSS ALL APPLICATION LAYERS.

candidate_lessons.title: TEST COUNT DOES NOT EQUAL ACCEPTANCE COVERAGE; EVERY CRITICAL ACCEPTANCE CONDITION REQUIRES EXPLICIT TRACEABILITY
candidate_lessons.description: A high passing test count (e.g. 50/50 passed) is insufficient without an explicit acceptance-matrix mapping each required state transition, race condition, and bypass path to concrete, passing tests.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: High test numbers created a false sense of comprehensive coverage while critical edge cases (such as globe click fallthrough under quarantine and RUNNING race conditions) remained untested.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Previous suite passed 50/50 tests, but lacked explicit coverage for globe click fallthrough under quarantine, context mismatch after result retrieval, and stale-result race during RUNNING.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Construct and maintain an explicit acceptance traceability matrix (Cases A through H plus regression cases) mapping every architectural invariant to dedicated automated tests.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: A PASSED TEST COUNT IS NOT AN ACCEPTANCE PROOF. EVERY CRITICAL ACCEPTANCE INVARIANT REQUIRES EXPLICIT TRACEABILITY.

candidate_lessons.title: PROTECTED REPOSITORY INTEGRITY HASHES DO NOT AUTOMATICALLY PROVE RESULT-LEVEL CRYPTOGRAPHIC VERIFICATION
candidate_lessons.description: Verifying SHA-256 hashes of protected repository files guarantees worktree integrity and non-tampering of canonical governance. It does NOT constitute cryptographic authentication or digital signature verification of execution result payloads.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Technical reporting loosely used the phrase 'cryptographic result verification' to describe repository SHA-256 integrity checks and simple identifier equality checks.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Prior report claimed 'cryptographic result verification' when the code only performed SHA-256 checks on 7 repository source files and ID equality checks on JSON responses.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Strictly distinguish repository file integrity checks (SHA-256) from result identity/context verification (matching job_id, mode, scenario_id) and true cryptographic signature verification. Never claim cryptographic verification unless digital signature verification is implemented.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: HASH EQUALITY != RESULT AUTHENTICATION. NEVER CLAIM CRYPTOGRAPHIC VERIFICATION UNLESS RESULT-LEVEL SIGNATURE CHECKS EXIST.

candidate_lessons.title: REANALYSIS AND MODELLED FORCING MUST NOT BE REPRESENTED AS DIRECT PHYSICAL OBSERVATION
candidate_lessons.description: Reanalysis products (such as Copernicus CMEMS ocean currents or ERA5 atmospheric winds) are numerical model integrations assimilated with sparse historical measurements, not direct physical observations. Describing modelled drift forcing as 'real physical observation' commits an epistemic error.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Environmental forcing datasets were colloquially referred to as 'physical data' because they describe physical oceanographic/meteorological variables.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Documentation occasionally referred to CMEMS currents as real physical observations. Physical observation is restricted to direct sensor telemetry (e.g. raw SAR backscatter, un-interpolated AIS transponder pings).
candidate_lessons.prevention: Strictly classify reanalysis and modelled forcing as DERIVED_MODELLED or REANALYSIS_FORCING, distinct from direct physical observations.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: REANALYSIS FORCING IS NUMERICAL MODELLING, NOT DIRECT PHYSICAL OBSERVATION.

candidate_lessons.title: STATE-MACHINE CLOSURE MUST EXPLICITLY AUDIT STALE-RESULT INTERACTION DURING RUNNING AND REPLACEMENT EXECUTION
candidate_lessons.description: When a new job execution is dispatched while a previous result is loaded, the state machine must immediately demote result freshness from LIVE_CURRENT to CACHED_LAST_LOADED (or purge if replacement is blocked/failed), preventing stale evidence from masquerading as current output during or after replacement execution.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Freshness transition was evaluated only upon successful result retrieval, leaving the prior result marked LIVE_CURRENT while a new execution was in-flight.
candidate_lessons.evidence: In App.tsx, starting a new real investigation left resultFreshness as LIVE_CURRENT while isExecuting was true. If replacement failed or blocked, stale evidence could appear current.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Demote prior live results to CACHED_LAST_LOADED immediately upon dispatch of a new job, and purge stale results if the replacement job fails or blocks.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: NEW EXECUTION DISPATCH IMMEDIATELY DEMOTES PRIOR LIVE RESULTS. BLOCKED REPLACEMENT MUST PURGE STALE EVIDENCE.

candidate_lessons.title: CANONICAL ENUM VALUES MUST NOT BE REPLACED BY BEHAVIORAL DESCRIPTORS
candidate_lessons.description: Application Gate values must strictly preserve their canonical vocabulary: READY, DEGRADED, BLOCKED. Behavioral descriptors such as FAIL-CLOSED or DEGRADED (OFFLINE) must not replace or displace the canonical state value in UI badges, type definitions, or report summaries.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Ad-hoc badge text rendered 'APPLICATION GATE: FAIL-CLOSED' instead of 'APPLICATION GATE: BLOCKED', conflating the behavioral descriptor with the state enum.
candidate_lessons.evidence: TopBar.tsx displayed 'APPLICATION GATE: FAIL-CLOSED'. Corrected to canonical 'APPLICATION GATE: BLOCKED'.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Ensure UI badge text, state machines, and report tables use canonical enum values strictly: READY, DEGRADED, BLOCKED. Secondary descriptors may only be appended parenthetically if necessary.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: CANONICAL STATE ENUMS MUST NOT BE REPLACED BY BEHAVIORAL DESCRIPTORS.

candidate_lessons.title: LIVE E2E DEMONSTRATIONS MUST CORRESPOND EXACTLY TO THE ACTION ACTUALLY EXECUTED
candidate_lessons.description: A browser test asserting backend disconnect and reconnect lifecycle must execute a genuine physical process stop and restart, not a page reload or component unmount. Conflating page reload with a daemon reconnection test produces false verification evidence.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: A verification step reloaded the frontend page and called it a reconnect test, omitting actual physical daemon process stoppage.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Step 10 previously claimed to verify reconnect by reloading the page. Corrected to physically terminate the backend server on port 8000, verify BACKEND UNREACHABLE and CACHED_LAST_LOADED, restart the server, verify BACKEND ONLINE while remaining cached, and dispatch fresh execution.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Never substitute a client-side reload for an external service lifecycle test. Verify disconnect by asserting connection drop at runtime, then verify reconnect after service restoration.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: RECONNECT VERIFICATION REQUIRES ACTUAL PHYSICAL SERVICE RECOVERY, NOT A BROWSER RELOAD.

candidate_lessons.title: CLOSURE REPORTS MUST NOT CONTRADICT THEIR OWN ACCEPTANCE MATRICES OR RUNTIME EVIDENCE
candidate_lessons.description: A closure report must maintain strict internal self-consistency between acceptance matrix statements, runtime test results, and browser narrative. Claiming a stage is BLOCKED in an acceptance table while describing it as active in runtime observations indicates an unresolved contradiction.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Narrative observations and acceptance tables were updated independently without an automated or forensic cross-consistency reconciliation.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Previous report Case B acceptance table specified 'TEMPORAL = BLOCKED', while Step 7 browser narrative stated 'Timeline nodes active'. Reconciled to enforce and document that timeline operational controls are disabled when temporal analysis is blocked.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Cross-check every acceptance criterion against runtime observations before declaring closure. Contradictions block certification.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: EVERY CLOSURE REPORT STATEMENT MUST BE INTERNALLY SELF-CONSISTENT AND EVIDENCE-BACKED.

candidate_lessons.title: STAGE EXECUTION COMPLETION AND SCIENTIFIC ACTIONABILITY MUST REMAIN DISTINCT WHEN COMPLETED STAGES HAVE BLOCKED OPERATIONAL CONTROLS
candidate_lessons.description: In a pipeline execution, a stage computation may successfully finish generating an artifact (e.g. stage_status COMPLETED), while the scientific grounding of that artifact remains unverified (e.g. TEMPORAL_ORDER_UNKNOWN), requiring operational interaction controls to be BLOCKED. Execution completion must never be conflated with operational actionability.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Pipeline orchestrator marked TEMPORAL stage COMPLETED because the artifact was computed, but the scenario's temporal chronology was unverified, leaving ambiguous whether timeline controls should be interactive.
candidate_lessons.evidence: In Scenario B, TEMPORAL computational stage ran successfully, but temporal_status was BLOCKED_AWAITING_AUTHORITATIVE_TIMESTAMPS. UI now respects scenario_metadata to disable temporal scrubber and playback controls while allowing SAR inspection.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Decouple computational completion from operational actionability. If a stage's scientific validity is blocked, its operational UI controls must be disabled even if computational execution finished.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: COMPUTATIONAL STAGE COMPLETION != SCIENTIFIC OPERATIONAL ACTIONABILITY.

candidate_lessons.title: ENVIRONMENT-ORIGIN TEST FAILURES REQUIRE CAUSALITY EVIDENCE BEFORE BEING CLASSIFIED AS PRE-EXISTING
candidate_lessons.description: When repository-wide test suites encounter collection or runtime errors, asserting that they are 'pre-existing' without investigating causality or capturing exact error modules is insufficient. Causality evidence must prove that the failing modules depend on uninstalled external packages and are completely untouched by the current task.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Collection errors were cited without an itemized failure inventory or verification that task changes did not induce the errors.
candidate_lessons.evidence: uv run pytest --collect-only produced 31 collection errors. All 31 failures were traced to missing 'torch' or 'PIL' in historical ML experiment scripts (e.g. train_exp*.py, test_gpu_qualification.py) which were never touched by this task.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Capture exact collection error traces and demonstrate that failing modules are outside the task changeset before classifying them as environment limitations.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: PRE-EXISTING CLASSIFICATIONS REQUIRE DEMONSTRATED INDEPENDENCE AND ITEM-LEVEL TRACEABILITY.

candidate_lessons.title: A FINAL STATE MODEL MUST PRESERVE ALL APPROVED DIMENSIONS AND OVERLAYS WITHOUT RENUMBERING OR REPLACING THEM
candidate_lessons.description: The authoritative system state comprises six orthogonal dimensions (CONNECTION STATE, RESULT FRESHNESS, JOB EXECUTION STATE, PROVENANCE CONTEXT, SCIENTIFIC VALIDITY, APPLICATION GATE) plus contextual and item-level overlays (RESULT_USAGE, Item ProvenanceClass). A report or interface must not renumber, collapse, or substitute overlays into the core six dimensions.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: A previous report version collapsed Connection State and replaced it with Result Usage as Dimension 2, distorting the approved six-dimension taxonomy.
candidate_lessons.evidence: V2 report erroneously listed RESULT_USAGE as Dimension 2 and omitted CONNECTION STATE from the enumerated six dimensions. Reconciled in V3 to restore the exact canonical six dimensions with RESULT_USAGE explicitly classified as a contextual overlay.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Never mutate or reorder the six canonical state dimensions. Maintain RESULT_USAGE strictly as a contextual overlay and ProvenanceClass at the item level.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: CANONICAL SIX DIMENSIONS AND CONTEXTUAL OVERLAYS MUST REMAIN TAXONOMICALLY PRESERVED WITHOUT COLLAPSE OR SUBSTITUTION.

candidate_lessons.title: AN ASYNC RESPONSE MUST BE PREVENTED FROM MUTATING STATE AFTER ITS EXECUTION CONTEXT IS SUPERSEDED
candidate_lessons.description: When asynchronous requests (job creation, polling, result fetching, history loading) resolve after a newer user action or execution dispatch has begun, the delayed callback must be rejected. Relying merely on job ID checks is insufficient if an older response arrives after a newer job is initiated.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Delayed getJobResult resolution from Job A could arrive after Job B dispatched or blocked, potentially overwriting currentJob, results, and quarantine status.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Added executionTokenRef generation counter in App.tsx. Any async resolution whose captured token does not match executionTokenRef.current is dropped without mutating state.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Guard all async resolution handlers with monotonic execution generation tokens or request cancellation guards so stale responses cannot overwrite state or resurrect purged evidence.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: ASYNC CALLBACKS MUST VERIFY EXECUTION GENERATION TO PREVENT STALE STATE MUTATION.

candidate_lessons.title: OPERATIONAL GATE MUST NOT BE INFERRED FROM CONTEXT QUARANTINE
candidate_lessons.description: Application Gate represents system operational readiness (READY, DEGRADED, BLOCKED) based on infrastructure and execution integrity, not whether a cached result mismatches the selected explorer scenario or mode. Contextual mismatch belongs exclusively to RESULT_USAGE = QUARANTINED.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: V2 narrative reported APP_GATE: DEGRADED in Cases E and F simply because scenario or mode was mismatched, conflating operational readiness with evidence quarantine.
candidate_lessons.evidence: In Cases E and F, backend is healthy and system is fully READY to execute new jobs. Quarantine of mismatched cached results sets RESULT_USAGE = QUARANTINED while Application Gate remains READY.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Enforce strict separation: Application Gate reflects backend connectivity and pipeline feasibility; RESULT_USAGE reflects context alignment of displayed evidence.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: APPLICATION GATE REFLECTS SYSTEM OPERATIONAL READINESS AND MUST NOT BE INFERRED FROM CONTEXT QUARANTINE.

candidate_lessons.title: FINAL ARTIFACT AUDITS MUST INSPECT THE FINAL BYTES AFTER ALL EDITS
candidate_lessons.description: Pre-edit, transient, or in-memory audits of final reports and certification documents are insufficient. A final artifact portability and compliance audit must inspect the literal bytes written to disk after all document modifications are complete to ensure zero non-portable links or forbidden phrases remain.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Earlier audit passes verified report text before subsequent edits introduced formatting changes or non-portable paths.
candidate_lessons.evidence: V4 forensic check runs byte-level programmatic scans on the final written file ocean_sentinel_evidence_state_semantics_final.md after all edits are finalized.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Perform document compliance audits strictly as a post-write verification on final file bytes before certifying closure.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: CERTIFICATION AUDITS MUST INSPECT WRITTEN FINAL ARTIFACT BYTES POST-EDIT.

candidate_lessons.title: CURRENT EXECUTION CONTEXT MUST BE VERIFIED AT RESULT ADOPTION, NOT ONLY AT DISPATCH TIME
candidate_lessons.description: When asynchronous job execution results resolve, the response must be matched against the CURRENT active UI scenario and mode at the moment of adoption, not solely against the parameters captured at dispatch time. If the operator changed scenario or mode while the result was pending, adopting the result as LIVE_CURRENT corrupts the active context.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: handleRunRealInvestigation checked res.scenario_id against the dispatch parameter scenarioId rather than active scenario state, allowing delayed responses to be adopted as LIVE_CURRENT even if the operator switched scenarios.
candidate_lessons.evidence: App.tsx was hardened using activeModeRef and selectedScenarioIdRef to evaluate res.mode === activeModeRef.current and res.scenario_id === selectedScenarioIdRef.current at adoption time. Verified in Tests 63 and 64.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Compare incoming async results against current live context refs at adoption time to prevent stale or mismatched live result assignment.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: RESULT ADOPTION MUST VALIDATE CURRENT LIVE CONTEXT AT RESOLUTION TIME.

candidate_lessons.title: WORKTREE CLOSURE MUST RECONCILE CUMULATIVE AUTHORIZED CHANGES WITH CURRENT UNTRACKED/GENERATED ARTIFACTS
candidate_lessons.description: A final worktree audit must not merely assert 'clean worktree' or 'no unauthorized changes' without explicitly categorizing all existing modifications and inspecting untracked or generated helper scripts. Temporary scripts must be safely removed or classified as intentional task artifacts.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Temporary hash-checking helper scratch/check_hashes.py was generated during testing and left untracked without formal accounting.
candidate_lessons.evidence: scratch/check_hashes.py was safely purged in V4 preflight, and all remaining modified files were classified into pre-existing authorized, milestone, or task artifacts.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Always reconcile cumulative worktree modifications and purge or categorize temporary helper artifacts prior to final certification.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: WORKTREE CLOSURE REQUIRES CUMULATIVE CLASSIFICATION AND TEMPORARY HELPER RECONCILIATION.

candidate_lessons.title: FRESH BROWSER COVERAGE MUST BE EXPLICITLY DISTINGUISHED FROM PRIOR ARTIFACTS AND TEST EVIDENCE
candidate_lessons.description: Fresh live browser verification must be distinguished from prior recorded browser artifacts and automated regression evidence. A report must not overstate final-session browser coverage to imply every acceptance row was freshly re-executed in the final browser session.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Prior closure reports collapsed fresh live runtime verification with historical session artifacts and automated test suites, obscuring the exact boundary of what was freshly run.
candidate_lessons.evidence: In V5 continuation, fresh live browser session directly executed Scenario A duplicate fail-closed, Scenario B distinct execution, and Scenario mismatch quarantine (Cases A, B, E). Remaining cases were established by prior recorded session artifacts and automated regression suites.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Explicitly itemize what was freshly executed in the final browser session versus what is evidenced by prior recorded artifacts or automated suites. Never claim universal fresh re-execution when only a targeted subset was freshly run.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: FINAL BROWSER COVERAGE MUST NOT BE OVERSTATED BEYOND FRESHLY EXECUTED SCENARIOS.

candidate_lessons.title: BOUNDED ASYNC RACE TESTS PROVE ABSENCE OF AUDITED DEFECTS NOT UNIVERSAL HAZARD ELIMINATION
candidate_lessons.description: A bounded set of deterministic async race tests (such as four deferred-promise tests) proves the absence of the audited defect patterns under those tested scenarios. It does not prove the universal elimination of all possible async or concurrency hazards.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Overstrong language in closure documentation converted passing results on specific race patterns into a universal claim of complete hazard elimination.
candidate_lessons.evidence: App.test.tsx Tests 57, 58, 63, 64 test four specific race patterns. Language was corrected from 'eliminates all async hazards' to 'No async adoption defect was observed across the four audited supersession and context-switch race patterns.'
candidate_lessons.prevention: Scope concurrency and race test claims strictly to the audited patterns and tested interleavings. State absence of observed defects rather than universal absence of risk.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: CONCURRENCY PROOFS MUST BE BOUNDED TO AUDITED SCENARIOS WITHOUT UNIVERSAL OVERCLAIMS.

candidate_lessons.title: APPLICATION PROVENANCE CONTEXT MUST REMAIN DISTINCT FROM ITEM PROVENANCECLASS AND MODE ROUTING
candidate_lessons.description: Application-level PROVENANCE / EXECUTION CONTEXT (Dimension 4 of the six-dimension model) must remain strictly distinguished from item-level ProvenanceClass, JobMode/PipelineType, composite scenario descriptors, and Scientific Validity.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Taxonomic conflation occurred when multi-tiered systems reused provenance terminology across application state, data item metadata, and dispatch modes.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Clarified in V5 report: Dimension 4 is PROVENANCE / EXECUTION CONTEXT. Item-level ProvenanceClass strictly retains canonical values (VERIFIED_OPERATIONAL, HISTORICAL_ARCHIVE, SYNTHETIC_DEMO, UNVERIFIED_EXTERNAL). JobMode/PipelineType governs routing. Composite descriptors describe scenario fixtures. Scientific Validity represents epistemic status.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Maintain strict categorical boundaries: never rename or mix item-level ProvenanceClass enums with application context dimensions or pipeline modes.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: APPLICATION PROVENANCE CONTEXT AND ITEM-LEVEL PROVENANCECLASS MUST REMAIN CATEGORICALLY SEPARATE.

candidate_lessons.title: FINAL EVIDENCE REPORTS MUST MAINTAIN EXACT TEST-NUMBER CONTINUITY
candidate_lessons.description: Documentation must agree with the literal highest test ID and total test count across all artifacts. Listing a lower test range (e.g. Tests 57-65 when Test 66 exists) introduces audit contradictions.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: Incremental addition of tests during audit closure was not propagated to every narrative description in the report.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Test 66 was added to verify duplicate pair execution leaving applicationGate READY. Report text in Section 15 was corrected from 'Added Tests 57–65' to 'Added/updated Tests 57–66', aligning with the 66/66 total.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Always cross-check the highest test index and total test counts across the test file, regression matrix, summary counts, and changed file lists before report sign-off.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: TEST RANGES AND TOTAL COUNTS MUST BE INTERNALLY CONSISTENT ACROSS ALL REPORT SECTIONS.

candidate_lessons.title: WORKTREE STATUS MUST DISTINGUISH NO UNAUTHORIZED CHANGES FROM LITERAL CLEANLINESS
candidate_lessons.description: When a repository has pre-existing, authorized tracked modifications (such as local tool configurations or dataset path adjustments), describing the worktree as literally 'clean' is false and contradicts git status. The accurate designation is 'NO UNAUTHORIZED CHANGES; PRE-EXISTING/AUTHORIZED MODIFICATIONS PRESERVED'.
candidate_lessons.root_cause: The shorthand word 'clean' was used loosely to mean 'no unapproved changes', conflating git cleanliness with governance compliance.
candidate_lessons.evidence: Git status shows modified tracked files (.gitignore, pyproject.toml, dataset.py). These were verified byte-for-byte against their pre-existing authorized baselines. Describing this as 'clean' was inaccurate; the accurate description is 'NO UNAUTHORIZED CHANGES; PRE-EXISTING/AUTHORIZED MODIFICATIONS PRESERVED'.
candidate_lessons.prevention: Never use 'worktree clean' when tracked diffs exist. Explicitly distinguish pre-existing authorized modifications from unauthorized changes.
candidate_lessons.governance_rule: WORKTREE GOVERNANCE MUST DISTINGUISH AUTHORIZED MODIFICATIONS FROM LITERAL GIT CLEANLINESS.
